latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of a self-improving question system that diagnoses and enhances prompt quality for better AI-generated answers.
- Introduces a silent 10-point quality checklist to evaluate prompt clarity, completeness, relevance, and rigour.
- Automatically enters "Enhancement Mode" to challenge users with targeted clarification questions when prompt quality is insufficient.
- Ensures critical output dimensions (clarity, context, success criteria) are addressed before generating an answer.
- Provides a clear, professional feedback format to guide users in refining their requests or proceeding as-is.
- Supports looping for iterative improvement, capping at 3 rounds unless the user opts to proceed.
